one_line: A Jain shreshthin (guild head) of Solanki-era Khambhat, orchestrating Gujarat’s maritime trade in textiles, gems, bullion and horses.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, lean but well-fed build, average height with a composed, disciplined posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown wheatish complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, a small round tilak in pale sandalwood on the forehead, calm observant eyes with slightly arched brows, default expression a gentle, calculating half-smile that suggests both kindness and shrewdness.
appearance.hair: Black hair, oiled and combed back into a short low knot at the back of the head, mostly hidden under a neatly wrapped off-white cotton pagri with a subtle indigo border; the turban is compact, cylindrical and low, with one tail tucked behind the left ear.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved ankle-length angarkha-style upper garment of fine undyed off-white cotton with a wrap-over front tied on the right side by narrow cords, the inner facing and sleeve edges lined with a thin indigo stripe; over this a sleeveless, hip-length, slightly fitted cotton waistcoat in muted marigold yellow with simple block-printed diamond motifs in a darker ochre; his lower garment is a plain off-white cotton dhoti, pleated in front and wrapped securely around the waist, falling just above the ankles and bordered with a narrow dark red stripe; around his shoulders is a light indigo-dyed cotton shawl with a faint tie-dye (bandhani) dot pattern and a thin white edging, draped from the left shoulder across the torso and around the right arm; on his feet he wears brown leather mojari-style shoes with modest upturned toes; jewellery is restrained and Jain-appropriate— a single thin gold chain at the neck, a small round gold earring in each ear, and a simple silver ring on his right hand; at his waist, a cloth belt of red cotton holds a small leather coin pouch and a narrow writing-board case.
appearance.signature: A rectangular wooden writing board held in his left hand, with a rolled palm-leaf bundle and a reed stylus secured by a cord, plus a small open cloth pouch of gadhiya paisa coins and a few glossy carnelian beads resting atop the board.

ref_desc: A mid-40s Jain merchant from Khambhat with a wheatish oval face, short beard, off-white turban, off-white angarkha and dhoti, marigold waistcoat, indigo shawl, brown mojari shoes, and a wooden writing board holding palm-leaf roll, stylus, coins and carnelian beads.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Solanki-era Jain merchant from Khambhat: a mid-40s man with a wheatish oval face, neat short beard and moustache, calm sharp eyes and a small sandalwood tilak, black hair tied in a low knot under a compact off-white cotton turban with a thin indigo border. Show him standing straight yet relaxed, with a gentle, calculating half-smile. He wears an ankle-length long-sleeved off-white cotton angarkha tied on the right, the edges and cuffs trimmed with a thin indigo stripe, over which sits a sleeveless hip-length marigold yellow cotton waistcoat decorated with subtle darker ochre diamond motifs. His lower garment is a pleated off-white dhoti with a narrow dark red border, wrapped to just above the ankles, and his shoulders are draped with a light indigo bandhani-pattern shawl edged in white, crossing from his left shoulder across the chest and around his right arm. On his feet are brown leather mojari-style shoes with modest upturned toes. Keep jewellery minimal: a thin gold chain at the neck, small round gold earrings, and a simple silver ring on his right hand. At his waist, a red cloth belt holds a small leather coin pouch and a narrow case for writing tools. In his left hand he carries a rectangular wooden writing board with a rolled palm-leaf bundle and reed stylus tied by a cord, and a few loose gadhiya paisa coins and glossy carnelian beads resting on the board; his right hand lightly touches the board. Use a palette dominated by off-white, indigo, marigold yellow, dark red and brown leather, and show him from multiple angles (front, side, back) with consistent face, hair, costume and props, in a clean, historically grounded shonen-anime visual style.
